rules.title: Over ten, the noun stays singular; mية becomes meet: meet mat3am
bullets: مية ends in a t-sound, so it becomes ميت before a noun
more than 10 = singular noun: مطعم not مطاعم

examples.line: ميت - meet (a hundred, before a noun)
أكتر من مية مطعم - more than a hundred restaurants

rules.title: Two verbs together: only the first is past: badaina nedrus
bullets: the first verb carries the past
the second stays in the present
ballashna works the same as badaina

examples.line: If there's two verbs only the first one is past
e7na badaina / ballashna nedrus ma3 ba3ad - we started studying together

rules.title: After lamma use ykoon: lamma ykoon 3indi
bullets: lamma (when) about the future needs يكون

examples.line: لما الكل في نفس المكان بيكون مميز - when everyone is in the same place it's special
لما يكون عندي ولاد - when I have kids

rules.title: aa5er + month = the end of that month; last month = September el-maadi
bullets: aa5er September = the end of September
a month name is like a proper noun
last September = سبتمبر الماضي or شهر تسعة الماضي

examples.line: آخر September - the end of September
bazonn enno ballashna aa5er September - I think we started at the end of September

rules.title: 'Was going to' = kunet ra7 + verb; ra7 never stands alone
bullets: kunet ra7 aakol = I was going to eat
you can't say راح on its own

examples.line: You can't just say راح on its own
ana kunet ra7 aakol, bas ma kunet ju3aan - I was going to eat but I wasn't hungry
